comparison.objective: Calibrates a torque-limiting clutch so it carries a light proof load and slips on a heavy one; the candidate sets a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1110 requires preload adjustment, selector operation, crank testing, and interpreting two load responses; the candidate requires jam-nut countertorque with coaxial tools.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1110 requires both proof tests at one unchanged preload and released stability; the candidate requires a retained 90° mechanical stop over three cycles.
comparison.reason: PR-1110 tests load-dependent clutch calibration, not locking an angular adjuster while resisting tightening reaction.

review_notes: Historical clutch calibration against2proofloads: exact original before distinguishing functional test.
